boss-careless.desc: a bath house regular at the tea counter

boss-careful.desc: a bath house regular at the tea counter

informant.desc: the bath house front desk attendant

red-herring-bath-regular.desc: a bath regular who pays in cash

s5-lurker.desc: a young man at the platform bench

extra:stranger.desc: a man at the lift doors

steps.line: {boss-careless} takes the end stool at the bath house tea counter in the early morning.
{go-between-clerk} pours a cup of tea and slides it across to {boss-careless}.
{boss-careless} walks out with the cup, and no payment crosses the counter.
{go-between-clerk} waves off {extra:patron}, who is pointing at the waiting queue.
{inside-officer} walks into the pools in the afternoon, no badge showing.
{boss-careless} passes {inside-officer} a rolled towel at the pool edge.
{inside-officer} carries the rolled towel out past the front desk.
{informant} stands at the front desk, eyes on the floor, as {boss-careless} walks by.

rows.title: Tab, slips, skipped door, exact change

steps.line: {go-between-clerk} and {boss-careless} chat about the weather across the tea counter.
{go-between-clerk} marks a paper tab and tucks it under the till.
{go-between-clerk} taps a stack of paper credit slips against the cup in front of {boss-careless}.
{inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk their patrol up to the bath house door.
{framed-officer} scans the door and writes the time in a paper notebook.
{inside-officer} keeps walking without a scan and waves {framed-officer} along.
{go-between-clerk} counts coins into the open palm of {boss-careless}, the exact amount, nothing over.
{red-herring-bath-regular} passes {go-between-clerk} a fold of notes in an odd amount.
{red-herring-bath-regular} and {go-between-clerk} argue over a tab, voices rising over the kettle.

rows.title: Roll past the bench, clerk gone

steps.line: {veteran-officer} sits on the bench by the front desk at midday.
{veteran-officer} says to {extra:patron}: "Fifteen days left on my badge."
{informant} sits on the same bench with a rice box and says nothing.
{inside-officer} walks past the bench with a rolled towel under {inside-officer.his} arm.
{informant} gets up from the bench and goes back to the front desk.
{go-between-clerk} stands at the tea counter in the early morning, a coat over the stool.
{go-between-clerk} walks out the service door with the coat over {go-between-clerk.his} arm.
{extra:patron} reads a handwritten sign taped to the tea counter: "Back soon."
{boss-careless} walks into the Cloud Pagoda lobby late at night, a folded towel on {boss-careless.his} arm.
{boss-careless} passes the Cloud Pagoda front desk without stopping.
{boss-careless} reaches for the lift panel and presses nine.
The lift doors close on {boss-careless}, and the floor counter climbs to nine.
Comm, one side: "Not now, Mama. I said ten."
{family-caller-officer} stands with {family-caller-officer.his} back to the lifts, comm at {family-caller-officer.his} ear.
{red-herring-night-courier} knocks at tenement door 4C before dawn and waits, a bag in hand.
{rookie-officer} stands on the stair landing, writing in a notebook.
{rookie-officer} points at the bag {red-herring-night-courier} is carrying.
{red-herring-night-courier} runs down the stairs, the bag clutched to {red-herring-night-courier.his} chest.
{inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk their patrol into the bath house lobby.
{framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "Left? The route sheet says right."
{framed-officer} stops to read the pool rules board, back to the tea counter.
{inside-officer} lifts a folded page out of the till drawer.
{inside-officer} tucks the folded page out of sight and walks on.
{burnout-officer} sits on a pool bench in the afternoon and stays there forty minutes.
{burnout-officer} eats from a rice box on the pool bench.
{burnout-officer} shrugs when {extra:patron} asks about the door scan.

rows.title: Route slip names the tea counter

steps.line: {rookie-officer} reads the paper route slip taken from the arrested lift hall mugger.
{night-stakeout-officer} points at one line on the slip: "tea counter, locker 14, Friday."
{rookie-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} talk over the slip, heads close together.
{night-stakeout-officer} seals the slip in an evidence bag.
{extra:patron} waits at the bath house front desk at opening, the chair pushed in and empty.
A shift sheet on the front desk has the attendant's name struck through in pen.
{veteran-officer} waits at the empty front desk in the late afternoon, hands folded.
{veteran-officer} asks {extra:patron} where the front desk attendant has gone.
{extra:patron} shrugs at {veteran-officer} and heads for the pools.
{desk-sergeant} stands at the station front screens at the start of the morning shift.
A wanted poster of the tea counter clerk has paint sprayed across the face.
{desk-sergeant} points {rookie-officer} at the paint across the poster.
{desk-sergeant} and {rookie-officer} talk in front of the painted poster.
{go-between-courier} knocks at Cloud Pagoda suite 9F late at night, a paper bag in hand.
Comm, one side: "You sound rough tonight. Yes, the bag is here."
{go-between-courier} passes the bag through a hand-wide gap in the suite door.
{go-between-courier} walks back to the lift with empty hands.
{night-stakeout-officer} stands at the far platform bench, a paper cup on the ledge.
{night-stakeout-officer} takes {s5-lurker} firmly by the arm beside the bench.
{night-stakeout-officer} holds up a photo log: {s5-lurker} seated across from the tea counter on two mornings.
{red-herring-bath-regular} passes {extra:cousin} a thin bag at the far end of the platform.
{red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 4C before dawn, holding flowers and a loaf of bread.
{extra:partner} opens door 4C and hugs {red-herring-night-courier} on the threshold.
{extra:partner} waves at a landlord bot humming down the corridor.
{night-stakeout-officer} waits by the bath house locker row in the early morning, still as a post.
{go-between-courier} walks into the locker room with a paper bag.
{go-between-courier} puts the paper bag in locker 14 and shuts the door.
{night-stakeout-officer} opens locker 14 with a master key.
{rookie-officer} reads the paper tabs and credit slips, cup counts beside the tea counter regular's name.
{night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} arrest {go-between-courier} at the locker row.
Posted to the mesh: a photo of {red-herring-bath-regular} with someone at a noodle stall, "Me and my cousin."
{red-herring-bath-regular} tells {rookie-officer} the cousin lent {red-herring-bath-regular.him} money to cover a debt.
{inside-officer} carries an evidence box down the station corridor in the early morning.
{desk-sergeant} reads a ledger page logged as evidence, with the initials of {framed-officer} penciled in the margin.
{desk-sergeant} finds the tea counter bag tag on the evidence shelf, tied to an empty bag.
{desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "{framed-officer} suspended pending review."
{framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over the log entry, tapping the page.
{night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at suite 9F in the early morning and wait.
{rookie-officer} opens the suite door with a hotel key card.
{rookie-officer} lifts a stack of folded towels off the bed.
Under the towels lie credit slips stamped with the tea counter's mark.
{rookie-officer} seals the credit slips in an evidence bag.
{framed-officer} passes {veteran-officer} {framed-officer.his} paper notebook.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} read nine dates marked in the notebook beside skipped door scans.
{rookie-officer} reads the comm log for the call to the courier: "Caller comm registered to {inside-officer}, 23:12."
{veteran-officer} reads a food counter receipt from the same night: "{framed-officer}, one bowl, 23:09."
{desk-sergeant} signs a locker search sheet and slides it across to {veteran-officer}.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} open the station locker of {inside-officer}.
{rookie-officer} unrolls a towel from the locker and lifts out credit slips.
{desk-sergeant} posts a correction under the suspension notice on the station screens.
{desk-sergeant} stands at the front screens and reads the correction twice.
The tea counter clerk's poster is clean again: "Wanted for questioning."
{extra:passerby} stops in front of the screens and points at the clean poster.
{night-stakeout-officer} watches the pools door in the early morning, a paper cup on the ledge.
{extra:tea-hand} stands at the tea counter beside an empty end stool.
{inside-officer} walks in through the bath house front doors, no badge showing.
Comm, one side, at the front desk: "Not today. Stay out of the pools."
{inside-officer} leaves by the side door without a look at the pools.
{veteran-officer} sits in the lift hall in the afternoon, watching the lift doors.
{informant} steps out of a lift with a rolled bag under one arm.
{veteran-officer} walks {informant} over to the bench outside the food counter.
{informant} tells {veteran-officer}: "Towels go up to nine on Fridays. The regular comes back for tea every morning."
{veteran-officer} and {informant} sit on the bench and eat without talking.
{night-stakeout-officer} stands at the pools door, a paper cup on the ledge.
{boss-careless} takes the end stool at the tea counter, as on every other morning.
{extra:tea-hand} pours tea and slides the cup across to {boss-careless}.
{framed-officer} stands at the front desk in uniform, notebook in hand.
{inside-officer} walks in through the front doors, no badge showing.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} step up to the stool and arrest {boss-careless}.
{framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} at the front desk.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} lead {boss-careless} and {inside-officer} out through the lobby.
{rookie-officer} reads a station 2 call log showing the same comm hour as the call to the courier.
{desk-sergeant} points at two matching lines, one from each station's log.
{desk-sergeant} and {rookie-officer} talk over the two logs side by side.
{inside-officer} asks {desk-sergeant} to swap {inside-officer.him} off the dawn shift, voice rising.
{desk-sergeant} shrugs at {inside-officer} and leaves the roster alone.
{inside-officer} reads the roster on the screen, {inside-officer.his} name unchanged on the dawn shift.
{night-stakeout-officer} stands at the pools door in the early morning, a paper cup on the ledge.
{boss-careless} takes the end stool at the tea counter, as on every other morning.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} step up to the stool and arrest {boss-careless}.
{framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} at the front desk.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} lead {boss-careless} and {inside-officer} out through the lobby.
{boss-careless} sits at the interview table, hands flat on the tabletop.
{framed-officer} passes the paper notebook across the table to {veteran-officer}.
{desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "Case closed."
{go-between-bartender} pours tea at the pool cart and serves {boss-careful} first.
Patrons stack up in a line at the pool cart while {go-between-bartender} waits.
{go-between-bartender} passes {boss-careful} a green token, a different color from the tea tokens.
{go-between-bartender} leaves through the service door, right on the hour.
{go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} bump shoulders at the lift doors without a word.
{go-between-courier} passes {go-between-bartender} a folded towel.
{go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} step into two different lifts.
{boss-careful} walks along the tenement corridor in the evening with a towel roll.
{boss-careful} unlocks flat 3B and goes inside.
The lamp in the window of flat 3B stays off after {boss-careful} goes in.
{inside-officer-extra} sits a little apart from the others at the briefing.
{inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant}: "What's the pools stakeout?"
{desk-sergeant} points at the schedule on the wall.
{inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing room.
Comm, one side, in the lift lobby: "I said ten. Ten, not eleven."
{family-caller-officer} leaves the lift lobby and is gone for ten minutes.
{family-caller-officer} comes back to the lift lobby carrying a takeaway bag.
{go-between-bartender} passes a token to {extra:stranger} at the lift doors.
{night-stakeout-officer} follows {go-between-bartender} at a distance toward the tenements.
{night-stakeout-officer} waits at the end of the tenement corridor before dawn.
{veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at flat 3B and wait.
{rookie-officer} lifts a pile of towels off a chair inside flat 3B.
Rolled inside the towels are credit slips with the tea counter stamp.
{rookie-officer} seals the credit slips in an evidence bag.
{veteran-officer} and {framed-officer} wait outside flat 3B in the early morning.
{boss-careful} opens the door of flat 3B, and {veteran-officer} and {framed-officer} arrest {boss-careful.him}.
{night-stakeout-officer} arrests {inside-officer} in the stairwell.
{framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer-extra} on the stairs below.
{veteran-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} lead all three out through the tenement lobby.
{desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "Case closed."
